goal: Replace modular/static proxy bodies with believable rigged humanoid characters while preserving film-safe identity cues, UE4.27.2 compatibility and the low-spec target.

hard_rules.legacy_obj_policy: Existing OBJ character pieces remain prototype/static fallback only. They are not accepted as final animated characters and are not converted to FBX as fake rigging evidence.
hard_rules.texture_policy: Use authored compressed source textures; pack AO/Roughness/Metallic when those maps exist and keep sRGB disabled on packed masks.
hard_rules.heavy_runtime_loading: FStreamableManager + soft object paths only for skeletal meshes/animation classes and other heavy final-character packages.
hard_rules.reference_policy: Use silhouette, wardrobe, age, race and role cues from project sources; do not require an exact actor scan or likeness.
hard_rules.acceptance_boundary: Natural-looking production character claims require real skeletal FBX, skin/deformation, animation integration, UE4 compile/import proof, PIE visual/motion review and target-device performance evidence.

face: separate eyelid/eye/mouth regions where rig permits
hair volume matching character identity without helmet-like blob shape
body: hands and feet scaled to race/body type
clothing layered over body rather than primitive-body color blocks
material: bounded material slots and scalable hair/cloth
camera_readability: LOD transition must not collapse identity

first_delivery_order.reason: parallel playable route and radically different silhouette
closest persistent companion and Hobbit rig-family reuse proof

required_bundle_per_character.skeletal_mesh: SK_<Character>.fbx with one skinned skeleton; no OBJ delivery for animated production character
locomotion_animation_options: Preferred: separate AN_<Character>_Idle/Walk/Run/Crouch/Jump/Interact/Attack FBX clips on the same skeleton
Acceptable first intake: one skinned SK_<Character>.fbx plus a documented skeleton compatible with an existing locomotion set
textures: Hair/clothing texture sets only when materially distinct
optional: weapon/equipment FBX if skinned or socketed

runtime_contract.fallback: Existing modular proxy remains visible only until the final rig bundle reports asynchronously ready.
runtime_contract.residency: Subsystem retains streamable handle while the rig is active/available; later pooling/route ownership may release bounded secondary assets.
